description: Buffy returns to Sunnydale for senior year as Faith arrives as a second Slayer and the apparently affable Mayor reveals plans for an Ascension that will turn graduation day into a battle for the whole town.

s03e01.description: Living anonymously in Los Angeles, Buffy tries to avoid her Slayer identity until missing street kids lead her to a demon operation exploiting vulnerable teenagers.

s03e02.description: Buffy’s return home is tense and resentful on all sides, but an argument-filled welcome party is interrupted when a cursed mask raises the dead.

s03e03.description: New Slayer Faith arrives in Sunnydale pursued by the vampire Kakistos, while Buffy meets the seemingly normal Scott Hope and Angel unexpectedly returns from hell.

s03e04.description: A brutal killing makes Oz the obvious suspect during the full moon, while Buffy secretly discovers that the returned Angel is alive but feral and chained in the mansion.

s03e05.description: Buffy and Cordelia compete for homecoming queen only to be mistaken for targets in a supernatural hunters’ contest, while Willow and Xander cross a line in their friendship.

s03e06.description: Candy sold to raise money for the school band magically regresses Sunnydale’s adults into irresponsible teenagers, leaving Buffy to uncover what is happening behind the distraction.

s03e07.description: Faith’s new Watcher arrives seeking a powerful artifact, while Buffy’s friends discover she has secretly been caring for the returned Angel and question whether he can be trusted.

s03e08.description: A heartbroken Spike returns to Sunnydale and kidnaps Willow and Xander for a love spell, inadvertently exposing their secret attraction and rupturing several relationships.

s03e09.description: Cordelia’s angry wish that Buffy had never come to Sunnydale creates an alternate reality ruled by the Master, where familiar friends have become very different people.

s03e10.description: At Christmas, Angel is tormented by visions of the people he murdered and manipulated by the First Evil into believing that killing Buffy is the only escape from his guilt.

s03e11.description: After finding two murdered children, Joyce leads a growing moral panic against witches that turns Sunnydale adults against Buffy, Willow and Amy under supernatural influence.

s03e12.description: On Buffy’s eighteenth birthday, the Watchers Council secretly strips her powers and subjects her to a dangerous test, forcing Giles to choose between duty and protecting her.

s03e13.description: Feeling useless beside Buffy and the others, Xander falls in with a group of reckless undead youths and ends up confronting a separate catastrophe while Buffy’s friends fight an unseen apocalypse.

s03e14.description: Faith draws Buffy into increasingly reckless Slayer behavior, and a confrontation with demons ends in a human death that tests how differently the two Slayers understand responsibility.

s03e15.description: Buffy tries to deal honestly with the accidental killing while Faith denies responsibility, then secretly approaches the Mayor and begins moving toward his side.

s03e16.description: A failed spell brings vampire Willow from the alternate reality into Sunnydale, forcing the real Willow and her friends to contain a dangerously confident version of herself.

s03e17.description: Faith and the Mayor attempt to remove Angel’s soul and recruit him, but Buffy and Angel stage their own deception to learn how far Faith has fallen and what the Mayor is planning.

s03e18.description: Buffy gains uncontrollable telepathy after killing a demon, and amid the mental noise she hears someone planning a mass killing at Sunnydale High.

s03e19.description: Buffy tries to destroy a key component of the Mayor’s Ascension, but Willow is captured during the operation and the gang must decide whether the artifact is worth her life.

s03e20.description: Angel ends his relationship with Buffy because he sees no future for them, while Buffy still has to protect the senior prom from a student planning a monster-assisted massacre.

s03e21.description: The Mayor prepares for his Ascension and Faith poisons Angel, forcing Buffy to hunt Faith for the Slayer blood that may be the only cure.

s03e22.description: Graduation day arrives with Angel still gravely ill and the Mayor ready to transform, so Buffy organizes the entire senior class for one last coordinated battle at Sunnydale High.
